initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Toys, Apparel, and Specialty Item
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to request a detailed quote for a selection of products we are considering for our upcoming promotional event. To ensure we have a comprehensive understanding of your offerings and pricing, please include the following items in the quote:

1. JoySprout Toy Car Set – We are interested in the standard packaging, suitable for retail display. Please specify any available options.
2. T-Shirt – We would like pricing for the basic T-Shirt (no specific item number), preferably in assorted sizes if possible.
3. Deluxe Toy Storage Bin – This is a specialty item we have seen referenced in industry reviews but could not locate in your catalog. If available, please provide details and pricing.

If there are any questions or clarifications needed, do let me know. We appreciate your attention to detail and look forward to reviewing your quote.

Best regards,
Larry King

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with intervention-triggering unknown item
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items and includes a request for an unknown, non-catalog item, triggering intervention. The tone is informal and the sender is Jim Schrute.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request – Toys, Snacks, and One Special Item
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

I hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out because I’d like to get a quote for a few things for our upcoming event. I’ve browsed your catalog and found some items that look perfect, but I also have a special request for something I didn’t see listed.

Here’s what I’d like:
- 2 sets of AdventureCraft Building Blocks (these are for our kids’ activity table)
- 5 Watermelons (for the refreshment stand)
- 1 WonderWagon Pull-Along Train (for the prize raffle)
- And, if possible, could you include a quote for a Jumbo Rainbow Beach Ball? I didn’t spot this on your site, but it’s a must-have for our games. If you carry anything similar, please let me know.

If you need any more info about quantities or delivery, just ask! Looking forward to your reply and the quote details.

Best regards,
Jim Schrute

Michael Reyes
